problems: hierarchy: data/colonies.csv has no row trust-territory-of-somaliland -> republic-of-italy, 1950..1960 (the dossier's type is colony and its notes ask for it; the Trust Territory page: 'It was administered by Italy before gaining independence'); without it the land is drawn direct in its own colour, not in Italy's tint.

The trust-territory-of-somaliland dossier now exists; p1950-p1959 events/5-7 were written as a patch around its absence and settle nothing in the trial (events/7 is dated 1960-07 and was already ruled applied). The orchestrator may withdraw them; I did not touch them.

Bridging dates: events p1930-p1939/4 (1937-01), p1940-p1949/15 (1944-01) and /19, /20 (1945-01) follow year-end keyframe snaps, which the compile applies after every event of the year (month 13); the pages date the retakes but not the handovers. Same-month events of a republic run before the Union's (dossiers are processed in slug order), so events/16 and /17 are dated one month after the Union's gains (July and August 1944).

Root cause left outside my windows: union-of-soviet-socialist-republics ledger/0 (30 December 1922, window p1920-p1929) takes the founding republics' land as Union-direct land, so the Ukrainian SSR holds 36 cells and the Byelorussian SSR 94 until 1939-44; my events give the cores back from 1944 only. A fix at 1922 belongs to the p1920-p1929 patch file.

keyframe_overrides/7 (kingdom-of-greece_1949) holds for the shape's whole span 1949-1962, so it acts in p1950-p1959 and p1960-p1969 as well as p1940-p1949; p1960-p1969 events/2 now settles nothing, events/3-8 settle 2 cells (Ukraine, Carpathians) and nothing. The 1945-1948 Greek keyframes leave 57 to 127 coastal and island cells unowned the same way (not patched: the brief names 1949-1962). About 25 coastal and island cells near Greece lie outside Natural Earth's country polygon and stay unowned.

Side effect seen in the trial: with the Byelorussian SSR holding its land the size rule gives 41 Bialystok-area cells to Poland at the 1945 snap, so p1950-p1959 events/1 (107 cells moved in 1950 before) has 41 fewer to move; the result is the one the page gives (Bialystok 'transferred back to Poland' in 1944-45).

Left alone, not transfers: 2 Carpathian cells stay Union-direct after 1945 (p1960 events/3 takes them in 1960); India has 25 coastal and border cells unowned since before 1947 (p1960 events/0 fills them from 1960); Poland has 10 (p1960 events/1); the 1960 independence specks above would need keyframe overrides spanning 1960-2023.
